title: Enigma — deployment profile
description: The Enigma was a rotor-based cipher machine patented by Arthur Scherbius in 1918 and adopted by the German military. Polish mathematicians broke early versions in 1932; at Bletchley Park, Alan Turing's team mechanized the break with the Bombe. Filed as JAH-CRY-000018 in the JAH Cryptography Database archive.
